{"metadata":{"description":"Telegram DM topics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: streaming, approvals, structured questions and session controls.","id":"gh:1433402118","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-telegram-bot","slug":"Boobaw/dsh-telegram-bot","topics":["aiagent","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","telegram","telegrambot"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Telegram DM topics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: streaming, approvals, structured questions and ses"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"pics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: streaming, approvals, structured questions and session controls."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-telegram-bot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Telegram client for DeepSeek Harness. It connects a DSH profile to a Telegram bot and keeps the same"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" DSH sessions available in both interfaces."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"First setup: https://youtu.be/QEeVucfBsWk"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Installation, bot token, the allowlist, `/start`, `/sessions` and a test prompt."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Enable Threaded mode"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"BotFather: **Bot Settings → Threaded mode → Enable**. Then enable **Disallow users to create new thr"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"eads**, so Telegram does not create a topic for every message sent in All."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- One Telegram topic per DSH session; Web and Telegram use the same session.
- Telegram mirrors only"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" turns initiated from Telegram; turns started in the Web UI stay in Web.
- `/sessions` lists workspa"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ces and existing sessions, and can create a new session in a selected workspace.
- Assistant answers"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" stream into the topic with Telegram Markdown formatting. Messages sent while the agent is working a"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"re queued and processed after the current turn; `/clear` removes that queue without stopping the cur"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"rent answer.
- Replies, quotes and forwards keep their context. Ordinary messages are passed unchang"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ed; only replies, quoted parts and forwarded messages get a short context block. A replied-to photo "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"or document is attached when Telegram allows the bot to download it.
- Reasoning and tool calls are "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"shown as temporary messages and removed as soon as the final answer is ready. Each tool-call entry i"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"s capped at three mobile lines.
- Inline controls for model, reasoning effort, permission mode and c"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ontext usage.
- Tool approvals with **Deny** / **Allow** buttons.
- `ask_user_question` support: opt"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ions, multi-select, custom answers and plan review.
- Documents and photos sent in a session topic a"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"re saved as DSH attachments and passed to the agent.
- `/new`, `/last`, `/rename`, `/fork`, `/clear`"},{"id":"p10s14","text":", `/stop`, `/restart`, `/status` and `/menu`.
- `/new` in a session topic starts a fresh DSH session"},{"id":"p10s15","text":" in the same workspace and binds it to the same topic; the previous session stays in DSH. In All it "},{"id":"p10s16","text":"opens a new session topic.
- `/fork [name]` creates a DSH session fork in a new Telegram topic; with"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"out a name it uses the previous title plus the branch number.
- The session picker also has **🔀 Cont"},{"id":"p10s18","text":"inue in Telegram fork**; automatic fork topics end with `(N)`.
- English and Russian bot messages.
-"},{"id":"p10s19","text":" Bot token stays in the DSH credential store."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` or newer, Node.js 22+.
- A Telegram bot token from @BotFather.
- **Threaded mode*"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"* enabled in BotFather, **Topics** enabled in the bot chat, and **Disallow users to create new threa"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"BotFather, **Topics** enabled in the bot chat, and **Disallow users to create new threads** enabled."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"From this repository:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"From npm:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` after installing or updating the plugin. Then open **Settings → Telegram**."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configure"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Field | Meaning |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Bot token | Token from @BotFather; stored in the credential store |
| `tokenRef` | Credential/env "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"name for the token; default `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` |
| `cwd` | Working directory for Telegram-created "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"sessions |
| `agentPreset` | Preset mounted for Telegram sessions; default `standard` |
| Allowed us"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ers | Telegram user ids or `@usernames` |
| Allowed chats | Telegram chat ids or `@channelnames` |
|"},{"id":"p21s5","text":" Show model thinking | Show reasoning in a temporary message |
| Show tool calls | Show tool calls i"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"n a temporary message |
| Bot language | `en` (default) or `ru` |
| Enable bot | Start or pause Tele"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"message |
| Bot language | `en` (default) or `ru` |
| Enable bot | Start or pause Telegram polling |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The token field only reports whether a token is configured. A token supplied through the environment"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" cannot be overwritten from the page."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## First run"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"1. Create a bot with @BotFather and save its token in **Settings → Telegram**.
2. In @BotFather open"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" **Bot Settings → Threaded mode**, enable it, and enable **Disallow users to create new threads**.
3"},{"id":"p24s3","text":". Open the bot chat, tap the bot name and enable **Topics**.
4. Send `/start` in **All**. With an em"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"pty allowlist the bot replies with your user and chat ids.
5. Add your user id to **Allowed users** "},{"id":"p24s5","text":"and press **Save**.
6. Send `/sessions` in **All**, choose a workspace and open or create a session."},{"id":"p24s6","text":"
7. Send a test message in the new topic."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"An ordinary message in **All** creates a new session topic in the default workspace. Commands such a"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"s `/sessions`, `/fork` and `/last` still work in All."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"If users are allowed to create threads, Telegram creates a topic before the bot receives the message"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"; the bot then warns about the BotFather setting on startup."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Send into a topic"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Scripts, scheduled jobs, other plugins and agents can post into a topic by name or thread id. The me"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ssage is also recorded in the session bound to that topic, without starting a turn; whoever answers "},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ded in the session bound to that topic, without starting a turn; whoever answers there next sees it."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"CLI from the package:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The request goes through a file spool under `$DSH_HOME/telegram/outbox`, so it needs no bot token an"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"d waits while DSH is stopped. Topic names ignore case; an unknown or ambiguous name is an error, and"},{"id":"p31s3","text":" nothing is created."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Host plugins can call:"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"The model-facing tool is `telegram_send`."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Troubleshooting topics"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"If every message in **All** creates a new topic, enable this BotFather option:"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Bot Settings → Threaded mode → Disallow users to create new threads**"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"The bot checks `has_topics_enabled` and `allows_users_to_create_topics` on startup, writes them to `"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"~/.dsh/telegram/status.json`, and posts a warning in the control chat when either setting is wrong."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"A correct configuration contains:"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"- The bot token lives in the credential store, not in the profile patch.
- Empty **Allowed users** a"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"nswers only in private chats with the setup hint.
- Group and channel chats require an entry in **Al"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"lowed chats**.
- Do not run two pollers with the same token; Telegram returns `409 Conflict`.
- A DS"},{"id":"p42s4","text":"H plugin runs in-process with the Host. Install only source you trust."}],"truncated":true}
